Kit summary

Toxic ThornsBasic
Deals 220% ATK DMG to a single enemy, with a 60% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Poison] for 2 turns, and with a 60% chance to inflict [Deep Poisoning I] for 2 turns.
Moon's GiftActive
Restores all allies' HP by 12% of Taff's Max HP, grants all allies 1 layer of [Heal] for 2 turns and cleanses 5 layers of DoT debuffs.
Spirit of LifePassiveExclusive Lv.3
Taff has a 100% chance to inflict a layer of [Poison] on all enemies for 2 turns at the beginning of each wave. At the beginning of self turns, Taff has a 40% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Poison] on all enemies for 2 turns. Meanwhile, Taff deals 50% more [Poison] DMG.
Touch of Thorns Lv.3Increases the [Poison] DMG dealt by Taff by 50%.
Wrath of NatureActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
Deals 260% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 100% chance to inflict a layer of [Intertwined] and a 100% chance to inflict a layer of [Poison] on them for 2 turns.
Touch of Thorns Lv.1Wrath of Nature: Reset the duration of all DoT debuffs.
Touch of Thorns Lv.2Targets who are inflicted with [Intertwined] by Taff will be additionally inflicted with [Severe Wound] for 2 turns.
